description: Land Title Settle Department - Nivitigala, Yakdehiwatta, Nivitigala D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620400 (16/0671 - Nivitigala)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land property rights, ownership transfers, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
